chemistry-killer-04.title: Acids, Bases, and Chemical Indicators
chemistry-killer-04.goal: Analyze the principles of Acids, Bases, and Chemical Indicators and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.
chemistry-killer-04.material:
Heerkul 25 °C, $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ 1.0 M 50 mL waxaa lagu daray $\mathrm{HCl(aq)}$ v mL oo xooggiisa aan la aqoon, waxaana la cabbiray heerkulka ugu sarreeya ee isku-darka. Heerkulka labada xal ee kahor isku-darka waa 20.0 °C.
Mugga HCl v (mL): 0 / 10 / 25 / 40 / 50
Heerkulka ugu sarreeya kadib isku-darka (°C): 20.0 / 24.5 / 29.0 / 27.5 / 26.75
Cufnaanta xalka isku-darka waa 1.0 g/mL, kuleylka gaarka ah waa 4.0 J/(g·°C), mugguna waa wadarta labada xal, kuleyl lama lumin. Falgalka neutralization waa $\mathrm{H^+ + OH^- \rightarrow H_2O}$. Waa maxay, si isku xigta, xoogga HCl(aq) iyo kuleylka neutralization (kuleylka la sii daayo marka 1 mol oo biyo ah la sameeyo, kJ/mol)?
chemistry-killer-04.s.s1.prompt:
Heerkul 25 °C, $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ 1.0 M 50 mL waxaa lagu daray $\mathrm{HCl(aq)}$ v mL oo xooggiisa aan la aqoon, waxaana la cabbiray heerkulka ugu sarreeya ee isku-darka. Heerkulka labada xal ee kahor isku-darka waa 20.0 °C.
Mugga HCl v (mL): 0 / 10 / 25 / 40 / 50
Heerkulka ugu sarreeya kadib isku-darka (°C): 20.0 / 24.5 / 29.0 / 27.5 / 26.75
Cufnaanta xalka isku-darka waa 1.0 g/mL, kuleylka gaarka ah waa 4.0 J/(g·°C), mugguna waa wadarta labada xal, kuleyl lama lumin. Falgalka neutralization waa $\mathrm{H^+ + OH^- \rightarrow H_2O}$. Waa maxay, si isku xigta, xoogga HCl(aq) iyo kuleylka neutralization (kuleylka la sii daayo marka 1 mol oo biyo ah la sameeyo, kJ/mol)?
chemistry-killer-04.s.s1.explain:
Tallaabo 1: Heerkulku wuu kordhaa marka v kordho ilaa uu gaadho ugu sarreeya 29.0 °C 25 mL, kadibna wuu hoos u dhacaa maxaa yeelay xalka aan neutralize-garayn ayaa kordha (mugga xalka oo dhan wuu kordhaa). Sidaa darteed 25 mL, H+ iyo OH- way is dheellitiranyihiin.
Tallaabo 2: NaOH 0.050 mol (1.0 M × 0.050 L) iyo HCl waxay falgalaan 1:1, sidaa darteed 25 mL waxay ku jirtaa HCl 0.050 mol. Xoogga = 0.050 mol ÷ 0.025 L = 2.0 M.
Tallaabo 3: Kuleylka Q = mcΔT = (50+25 mL × 1.0 g/mL) × 4.0 × 9.0 = 75 × 4.0 × 9.0 = 2700 J.
